messages:
sanjay: Heads up — small-batch decode p99 spiked on canary this morning. Initial triage points to the kernel selector choosing the FlashPaginated variant during the prefill->decode boundary which seems to increase kernel-switch and shared-memory churn for microbatches.

marta: Ugh, saw the alert. Do you have concrete numbers? I noticed 30–80ms p99 uplift for 1–4 token responses.

sanjay: Yep, quick snippet from perf profiler (shortened):

```
kernel: fused-attn-v2      prefill: 0.9ms  decode: 1.2ms
kernel: flashpaginated-v1  prefill: 0.7ms  decode: 3.1ms  # big decode cost on small batches
kv_cache: evict_stall_ms   1.1ms avg spikes to 3.8ms at boundary
kernel_switches: 2-4 per request on warm paths
```

eli: That decode delta looks plausible. Our selector currently checks is_prefill + mean_seq_len to pick paged/flash. For tiny decode batches we should bias toward fused-attn to avoid the expensive decode path. Could be is_prefill flag flip bug too.

kevin: Reproduced locally with microbench (A100x1):

```
bench smallbatch-decode --model x-large --batch 1..4 --seq 8
# fused-attn-v2: p99 = 18ms, avg = 9ms
# flashpaginated-v1: p99 = 42ms, avg = 21ms
# switching overhead observed ~8-12ms when kernel_switches > 1
```

perf-bot: CI-bench smallbatch-decode (pr:perf/418) failed: p99 regression +28ms vs baseline — tagging @eng-runtime.

marta: Short-term mitigation: change selector to favor fused-attn-v2 when (seq_len <= 32 AND decode_batch_size <= 4). Also instrument kernel_switch_count and kv_evict_ms. That should cut the p99 without touching paged-attn for long-prefill workloads.

sanjay: Agreed. Another contributing factor: paged-attn's page cleanup triggers during prefill end and races with decode allocation leading to IPC stalls. Suggest soft cooldown: if we switch from prefill->decode within 50ms window, stick to previous kernel for first N decode microbatches.

eli: I'll draft a PR: heuristic + two microbench tests (batch 1..4 seq 8 and bursty prefill->decode ramp). Will add unit to the selector and a flag to enable soft cooldown.

kevin: I'll canary the change on dedicated-staging pool (dedicated-staging-2). Plan: 100rps, mix of short chat workloads, 2h run. If p99 improves, we roll to staging. Tagging @marta for rollback plan.

marta: :thumbsup: Also add two console metrics: op.kernel_switches and op.kv_evict_ms so we can chart before/after. Please add an alert if kernel_switches/sec > threshold during steady-state.

sanjay: Adding a short note to internal perf doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/perf/smallbatch-decode — will update after PR merges. Thanks folks, let's keep the canary tight.
